 Slavia Prague vs Arsenal: Recent form
 Slavia Prague have recorded two wins, two draws and one defeat in their last five competitive matches. They most recently beat FK Jablonec 5-0 in the Czech league. Before that, Slavia beat Slavia Brno 4-0 in the cup and drew 2-2 with Fenerbahçe in the Champions League.
 Arsenal have three wins, one draw and one defeat from their last five competitive matches. The Gunners most recently won 1-0 away at Liverpool in the Premier League. Before that, they beat Everton 2-0 and won 1-0 away at Nottingham Forest. Across those five matches, Arsenal scored six goals and conceded three.
